lines.quote: Samayam ledu mithrama...
lines.note: 24 hours is less than you think. Open your laptop!

lines.quote: LMS ante flower anukunnava? FIRE-U!
Time undi anukunte, adhe mundu padipoye shatru ra!
Roju oka page rasthe, deadline nee mundu mokaalladuthundi!
Naaku telsu, nuvvu ippude chesthav. Kaakapothe repu panic chesthav!
Assignment ante bhayam kaadu ra, avoid cheyyadam bhayam!
lines.note: Open it and write the first line.

lines.quote: Ee roju start chesthe champion, repu start chesthe passenger!
Deadline dooram ga kanipisthundi, kaani daggara ayye vegam telusa?
Coffee teesuko, laptop open cheyyi, story ippude modalavvali!
Calm ga undu, kaani time waste cheyyaku ra!
Flute jinka mundu oodu... LMS server mundu kaadu!
Little hearts tintava ra thuppasi vedhava? Velli assignment rayi!
Aaru gantalu ra... aaru ante chala, kaani aalochisthe thakkuva!
Instagram ni konchem aapu, assignment ni konchem paluku!
Nuvvu nilabadithe deadline venakki vellali, kurchoni scroll chesthe kaadu!
Ee 6 gantalu nee kosam kaadu, nee marks kosam!
Lunch tarvata laptop, laptop tarvata relax. Plan clear ga undi!
Sink lo plates ki time undi, assignment ki ledu. Pani modalettu!
Eppudaina cheddam anukunnava? Ade ippudu ra!
Chai tarvata chaduvu kaadu, chaduvu tarvata chai. Start cheyyi!
Don't trouble the deadline! If you trouble the deadline, deadline troubles you!
YamaGola aypotundi ra... LMS lo submit chey 2 hours ey undi!
Rendu gantalu ra, entry ivvali, ending ivvali!
Deadline gadiyaram chuste gundellu parugulu, ippude pani chey, bayam povali!
Ippudu em chesthav ani adagaku, em chesthunnavo choopinchu!
Mundu lekha, tarvata lekkalu. First paragraph rayi ra!
Friends ki reply tarvata ivvachu, ippudu paper ki ivvu!
Time ni nuvvu kodithe time ninnu kodithundi ra, jagratha!
Charger teesuko, water bottle teesuko, war ki ready avvu!
Plan A submit, plan B submit, plan C panic. Nuvvu A lo undu!
Akhandaaaa!!! LMS server eppudaina padipovachu, submit it immediately!
Arey, nenu matladedi vinapadatledaa!! Just 60 minutes left.
Okka gantalo history rayavachu, assignment submit cheyyochu!
Ippudu kaakunte ippudu ledu ra, gadiyaram aagadu!
Server slow ayye mundu upload kottu, tarvata prarthinchu!
Final draft perfect ga lekapoyina parledu, submit chesina draft ye nijam!
Ee ganta nuvvu chesindi ee semester ni maarchesthundi!
Perfect kaadu, pooti cheyyadam mukhyam. Ippude finish!
Nenu cheppanu, time ledu. Nuvvu cheppakapoyina chesthav ani telusu!
Siren motha modalaindi, upload button daggara ready ga undu!
Arey entra idhi... asalu em jarugutondi akkada! 50 mins ki submit nokkara!
Last minute server crash chusava... mind block aypoddi! UPLOAD UPLOAD!
Anumanam ledu, anchana ledu, 50 nimishaalu matrame. Keyboard kottu!
Cheppina maata vinte hero, vinakapothe zero. Submit ki velthunnav kadha?
Ee 50 nimishaalu nee fate ni rase pen ra!
Doubt unte comment lo, kaani paper lo rayi. Clock aagadu!
Ammaku cheppina maata gurthundha? Idi cheyyali ra, ippude!
Tension padakunda tension ga cheyyi: 50 minutes, one upload!
Laptop charge lo pettu, assignment ni attack lo pettu!
Fast ga type, slow ga aalochinchadam ippudu luxury ra!
10 nimishaalu ra! Ippude upload cheyyi, aalochinchaku!
Clock cheppindi: ippude submit, ippude!
Last minutes ra! Ippudu kaakapothe inkepudu? SUBMIT NOW!
Padi nimishaalu! Pen kaadu, mouse teeyyi, upload cheyyi!
Dhairyam ga cheyyi: select file, click upload, deep breath... DONE!
Ippude ippude ippude! Gadiyaram aarpadam ledu, nuvvu aagakura!
10 nimishaalu: 9 lo upload, 1 lo prarthana!
Ee 10 nimishaalu lo hero evaro telusa? Submit chese nuvve!
Panic ippudu kaadu, submit ippude. Tarvata paniki panic chesko!
Last chance train vellipothundi ra, ekki kurcho, upload cheyyi!
